status: PROSPECTIVE; source metadata only; no dataset rows, labels, outcomes, model outputs, or scores opened for this protocol. Commit this protocol before any new row access or model choice.
objective: A source-first neutral evaluation contributing evidence to the existing 21-cell endgame. This protocol, any synthetic control, and any single study are not endgame completion or an overall superiority claim.

authority.precedence: The existing endgame comparison, victory, certification, resource, and statistical contracts remain binding. This protocol cannot lower them.

scope.required_scope: Keep all 21 dimensions, all endgame source/mechanism branches, 51-language scope, K=1000, and substantive 8192-token long-context scope. The 16384-token long-context target remains a stretch measure. A source gap is UNMEASURED, not scope removal or a terminal block.
scope.exposure_language: A public, workflow-sealed test partition may be prospective confirmation for this selection process if it has not informed this study's choices. It is public/exposed evidence, not universally fresh; unknown pretraining or prior public use is disclosed, never assumed absent.

labels.MEASURED: Observed metadata or persisted future results, with evidence path; publisher statements remain attributed claims.
labels.INFERENCE: Leakage, feasibility, or statistical reasoning, not an observed outcome.
labels.HYPOTHESIS: Proposed sources, pools, and mechanisms not yet acquired or evaluated.

prohibitions: Never represent generated or agent-authored labels as human annotation.
Never use uncertain agent semantics as gold.
Never treat teacher means as factual human gold or use them to fill missing labels.
Never combine public human, weak, teacher, or synthetic strata to manufacture sample size or transfer.
Never infer data rights from model-weight or repository-code licenses.

source_first_workflow.freeze_inputs: Commit this protocol, neutral_source_inventory.json, COMPETITOR_MATRIX.json, LAYA.json, JEV.json, and exact source/model revision and license records. At acquisition record their exact-byte SHA-256 values; this protocol invents none.
source_first_workflow.rights_gate: Before row acquisition, record the source-specific data grant, terms, attribution, upstream/privacy limits, and whether training, evaluation, and redistribution are permitted. Acquire only permitted data and metadata. Research-eval-only data stays outside shipping training/artifacts; conditional sources are not acquired until their stated review passes.
source_first_workflow.group_and_manifest: After protocol commit, acquire only eligible source revisions. Build input-only lineage/dedup components before allocation: source case/document/prompt/conversation/template IDs, translations, repeated states, candidate catalogues, exact normalized-text hashes and verified near duplicates. Keep connected components together across source partitions. Preserve prior Vey/model exposure and every exclusion reason. Commit train/dev/calibration/final group manifests, provenance, licenses, endpoint registry, and split hashes before any new model, architecture, prompt, route, or shortlist choice. Actual post-grouping counts and hashes are recorded then, not fabricated here.
source_first_workflow.allocation: Respect official source train/validation/test roles. A component connected to test cannot enter train/dev/calibration. Use deterministic SHA-256 ranking over the frozen study seed and input-only group ID for any within-role carve; commit the seed, algorithm, realized IDs, and unused ledger before selection. A public final is eligible only if no known prior Vey study-selection use; otherwise it is a legacy replication stratum. No label- or outcome-driven allocation.
source_first_workflow.partition_access: Expose train/dev to selectors only after manifests freeze. Calibration membership is frozen now but labels are fit-only after model/route selection. Keep final labels out of selection; a public dataset is workflow-sealed, not claimed secret or universally fresh. Use a local sealed evaluation process or non-selecting custodian; do not require hired human authors, annotators, reviewers, or custodian as a default prerequisite.
source_first_workflow.final_lock: Before final execution freeze and hash model/checkpoint, tokenizer, code, prompt/decomposition, exact workflow, route, calibration, precision, thresholds, failure/fallback policy, cache policy, and complete metric/contrast registry. Run final once; no tuning, exclusions, extra groups, changed margins, alpha, or endpoint additions after final access. Preserve exposed results as replication only.

allocation_parameters.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, finite numbers only; ordered lists preserved.
allocation_parameters.input_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace, strip. Serving bytes unchanged; preserve negation, numbers and punctuation.
allocation_parameters.group_id: SHA256 of canonical [source_id, pinned_revision, sorted_original_lineage_ids, sorted_normalized_input_sha256s]. Labels, ratings and outputs never enter IDs.
allocation_parameters.near_duplicates: Add edges for exact normalized input or source lineage; verify character5gram-set Jaccard>=0.90 for substantive evidence, not shared boilerplate. Connected components remain inseparable; record every edge/reason and unresolved template lineage.
allocation_parameters.rank:
Ascending SHA256 UTF8(seed+'
'+purpose+'
'+source_id+'
'+group_id); tie by group_id. Source partition precedence precedes ranking.
allocation_parameters.allocation_rule: Official labeled test components are confirmation-only. If no labeled test exists, reserve official labeled validation for confirmation-only; unlabeled official test never gains invented gold. Otherwise validation is eligible for dev/calibration only. Rank eligible validation and alternate groups into dev/calibration until each1024 cap. Within official train, rank components and allocate by rank mod10:0/1 dev,2/3 calibration,4..9 train, respecting caps and filling no partition from confirmation. Validation-filled dev/calibration caps leave train-designated overflow unused, not moved into training. Every allocation uses inputs only. Final candidate groups retain legacy/public exposure status. Actual counts and unused IDs recorded; caps do not guarantee precision.
allocation_parameters.languages: Apply MASSIVE caps to base utterance groups, retaining all51fixed locale descendants for each retained base. Never multiply independent n by locales.
allocation_parameters.supplement_family_allocation: Hash-rank declared W/C/L abstract family IDs by purpose author-family before generation; assign the fixed train/dev/calibration/final family counts in order. Seed-only descendants do not become independent meanings.

source_label_metric_limits.HelpSteer2: Main aggregate scores alone cannot recover individual frequencies. Pinned retained-rater disagreement arrays can support empirical categorical NLL/Brier and ordinal metrics against the filtered-rater target, after rights, coverage, split joining and grouping pass. Never claim unfiltered human/population calibration or fabricate frequencies by rounding an aggregate. Preference all_preferences_unprocessed is a separately defined signed pairwise-human target, not the five-attribute distribution.
source_label_metric_limits.teacher_distributions: Typed-decisions NLL/Brier targets are publisher teacher-preference distributions, not human factual calibration. Report separately from human-label classification.
source_label_metric_limits.missing_scope: These limits keep unsupported probability or arbitrary-criterion endpoints unmeasured and trigger another source study; no surrogate silently fills them.

controlled_supplement.purpose: Small bounded agent-authored pools for deterministic objective controls and implementation checks only. They are synthetic/agent-authored, not natural human evidence, production logs, or semantic gold. Generate only after this protocol is committed; commit generator code before building rows. No human workforce, paid authoring, model teacher, or provider call is presumed.
controlled_supplement.label_rule: Gold is produced by a frozen explicit simulator/formal rule and independently implemented reference evaluator. A text variant is eligible only when its meaning is determined by the frozen grammar and reference checks agree; uncertain/ambiguous wording gets no gold and is not silently removed after outputs. DEV-only pre-final validity checks may reject a faulty generator by input/rule criteria. Unvalidated free-form agent-authored semantics are exploratory and cannot score a capability endpoint.

W_workflow_controls.unit: Independent simulator state/session seed; 16 scenario families with 16 base groups each; family is an outer cluster.
W_workflow_controls.family_split: 8 train, 2 dev, 2 calibration, 4 final families, assigned before generation.
W_workflow_controls.content: Structured synthetic Choice/Bool/Score/ACT, evidence, exact preconditions, changed-state, and repeated-state controls with oracle outcomes. Report only as synthetic controlled workflow behavior, never real business benefit.

C_criterion_and_composition_controls.unit: Independent candidate-bearing states across 32 formal criterion families, 8 states per family; family is the outer generalization cluster.
C_criterion_and_composition_controls.family_split: 16 train, 4 dev, 4 calibration, 8 final families, assigned before generation; final families hold criterion meanings and associated field/schema forms.
C_criterion_and_composition_controls.variants: Fixed-grammar aliases, polarity reversals, conditional forms, pair/three-atom compositions, and ordinal/Boolean transforms are descendants of the same state group, not new n. Oracle outputs come only from the explicit formal semantics. This is controlled synthetic transfer, not arbitrary natural-criterion gold.

K1000_control.unit: A subset of C final groups, not additive to its cap.
K1000_control.construction: Each has 1000 distinct programmatically validated candidates, no dummy repetitions; the frozen objective is scored over K=[2,4,8,16,32,64,128,255,512,1000] using label-independent nested subsets. Derived K/permutation rows remain grouped. This establishes only synthetic objective K=1000 behavior, not natural semantic K=1000 support.

L_long_controls.unit: Independent generated evidence documents in 16 dossier families, 8 documents per family; family is the outer cluster.
L_long_controls.family_split: 8 train, 2 dev, 2 calibration, 4 final families, fixed before generation.
L_long_controls.length: Substantive document target >=8192 tokens under a frozen tokenizer, with 16384 as stretch; no padding or unrelated concatenation. Oracle retrieval/extraction/Boolean outcomes are deterministic. Synthetic long evidence cannot replace or upgrade natural QASPER evidence.

controlled_supplement.M_multilingual: No agent-authored translations or labels are presumed valid. MASSIVE supports its existing human-labeled intent/slot task only. Additional 51-language Bool/Score/negation/composition capability needs objective language-specific validation on DEV (for example a separately pinned public labeled task or independently reproducible controlled language grammar). If validation is unavailable or fails, that capability remains UNMEASURED and triggers a new preregistered source/mechanism; do not impose a human-only default or claim 51-language support from tokenizer acceptance.
controlled_supplement.provenance_separation: Keep natural public human labels, public weak labels, teacher preferences, and synthetic oracle targets in separate manifests and results. Synthetic controls may test exact determinism, invariants, failure handling, composition plumbing, candidate-order invariance, and measured runtime; they cannot supply natural-quality wins or fill a missing public human endpoint.

shared_decision_and_group_contract.unit: One primary question per independent source state/document/session for each endpoint; retain source/group IDs, full serving input, permitted evidence, typed candidates/rubric, and label provenance. Use a distinct group ID for each source-independent base unit; criterion/world family is an outer inferential cluster where the claim generalizes across families.
shared_decision_and_group_contract.fairness: All arms receive identical evidence, questions, candidate universe, rubric, exact fields, and shared exact workflow code. Exact arithmetic, joins, thresholds, eligibility, ties, preconditions, and state transitions are computed identically. Model-private summaries/gold are forbidden except in a separately named shared evidence-oracle control. No live actions or external side effects.
shared_decision_and_group_contract.interfaces: Choice uses stable candidate IDs/descriptions; Bool reports P(true); Score uses the source rubric or frozen five-level rubric; rank uses the same candidates; extraction cites the same evidence catalogue; action/tool selection invokes shared local preconditions only. Source-native label and output semantics take precedence where compatible and are frozen before selection.
shared_decision_and_group_contract.transforms: All candidate/order, polarity, ordinal, Boolean, criterion-swap, locale, chunk/position, repeated-state, and changed-state variants remain inside their parent group. Use all preregistered criterion pairs, not only label-changing pairs. Report unconditional accuracy, correctness on gold-changing pairs, changed-to-new rate separately, both endpoints correct, and unwanted change on stable gold; correct-new does not require model_changed.
shared_decision_and_group_contract.holdouts: Hold entire source lineage, aliases, semantic families, fields/schema forms, author/template families, and composition descendants as specified before model choice. No final aliases or field definitions in train/dev/calibration. Public benchmark familiarity and possible pretrained overlap remain exposure disclosures, not claims of universal freshness.
shared_decision_and_group_contract.ambiguity: Preserve accepted label sets, source uncertainty, abstain/UNKNOWN and legitimate ambiguity. Never drop hard items or label disagreement because a model fails. Missing public gold stays unlabeled; do not pseudo-label final.

Laya.metadata_pin: research/competitors/LAYA.json at source inspection commit 859b8ee595cc04f84dd2af476d6d1d90ec1fea46; release 0.3.25, release commit 8a976468b57c1b53541363dc86523263c9b68d34.
Laya.routes: Use typed specialist for typed-decisions and matching business workflows; multilingual route for each non-English MASSIVE locale; English generic route for English classification/intent/emotion/ordinal/Boolean/criterion tasks. For long context compare feasible English and multilingual routes on DEV. Select the highest DEV-quality appropriate route under a frozen rule; retain materially distinct Pareto routes used for claims. No final route selection.
Laya.limits: Evaluate documented SDK/native support and shared decomposition rather than crippling routes. Record actual visible tokens, truncation, collapsed options and all fallback/decomposition cost. Current metadata documents HTTP maximum 100 Choice options and 8192 total budget; K>100 HTTP-native is unsupported absent a refreshed source pin. The multilingual 8192 context is a claim, not verified capability; its default max_len is 1024.

Jev.metadata_pin: research/competitors/JEV.json; Python SDK v0.7.2 commit f078f1e208a0d885154dc758344ae4fce77ac168; JavaScript SDK v0.6.0 commit 66880ccded6cb642dc1809620c2b108c33730214. Model-weight and immutable docs revisions are unavailable; refresh and pin before direct evaluation.
Jev.status: Direct Jev evidence is required by the endgame victory contract and has not been authorized or performed.
Jev.no_access_gate: Before any authenticated call, parent must establish explicit written authorization for competitive Vey research despite MCA 2.3(b), permission to transmit the exact inputs, and an existing approved request/token/cost budget. Key presence is not authorization. No account creation, legal acceptance, credential inspection, paid request, or disclosure is authorized by this protocol.
Jev.timing: Hosted round-trip may be reported with network and client path disclosed. Private Jev server hardware/model-only latency and memory are unavailable; do not claim same-hardware performance equivalence or superiority.

competitor_routes_and_access.evidence_rule: Competitor vendor numbers are not direct evidence. Compare the strongest appropriate Laya routes and directly evaluated Jev where authorized; preserve unsupported/unavailable cells explicitly.

frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.registry: Before final, freeze every preregistered critical endpoint, applicable source stratum, direct competitor contrast, direction, margin, primary group unit, exclusions, and multiplicity denominator. This full M registry is immutable after final access.
frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.familywise: Two-sided nominal 95% Bonferroni intervals across every preregistered critical endpoint versus each directly evaluated competitor. Use paired cluster bootstrap with 10000 resamples, seed 0, resampling independent groups and the relevant outer family cluster. Exact Clopper-Pearson harmful-event bounds apply to exact binary/bounded-risk cases where appropriate.
frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.zero_discordance: A degenerate bootstrap or zero observed harmful discordance alone is not NI. Require the exact harmful paired-discordance Clopper-Pearson upper bound to clear the frozen margin or a deterministic proof of identical outputs.
frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.interpretation: Superiority requires the simultaneous interval to exclude zero favorably. NI requires exclusion of the frozen material-regression margin. Non-significance is not equivalence. Report each source and provenance stratum separately; no favorable macro can erase a failed critical endpoint.
frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.precision_gate: Before final, use DEV only and the frozen registry/grouping to simulate expected simultaneous interval width and power at the realized planned group counts, including family clustering and exact bounds. For NI, test whether planned n can resolve the margin under the no-difference case; report assumptions and variance. DEV can support route/precision feasibility, never final-effect selection. If precision is not credible, keep the endpoint UNMEASURED/inconclusive and preregister another source or mechanism; do not widen alpha, relax a margin, or grow the final after outcomes.
frozen_endpoint_registry_and_statistics.outcome_scope: No minimum target count or zero-variance shortcut guarantees NI. A final can be descriptive when the pre-final precision gate fails, but cannot be promoted as a pass; continue with a separately preregistered justified source/mechanism rather than treating this failure as terminal.

resources_and_execution.current_authority: This protocol authorizes no row acquisition, model/weight download or loading, training, evaluation, authenticated request, paid call, or execution. Parent owns execution after commit and audit.
resources_and_execution.local_plan: Estimate source/model storage and memory from metadata before acquisition; stream or mmap large inputs/features, serialize GPU residency, and pause on RAM/swap pressure. Keep raw rows, labels, credentials, weights, and large features outside Git. Measure full end-to-end costs, including tokenization, exact code, batching, caches, certification, fallback, and output assembly.
resources_and_execution.timing: Use same local hardware/runtime/precision/cache settings for Laya and Vey. Record p50/p95/p99, throughput, memory, startup and failures; pair/interleave quiet-hardware blocks. Hosted Jev and local model-only timings are not apples-to-apples.

failure_and_next_branch.unmeasured_not_terminal: A license, source-count, lineage, language-validation, token-length, group-independence, resource, authorization, or precision failure leaves the affected endpoint UNMEASURED. Record exactly what failed and why. Preserve the 21-cell goal and propose/commit the next justified source or mechanism before its affected rows/outcomes; do not infer semantic absence or stop endgame solely from this protocol's source failure.
failure_and_next_branch.no_silent_substitutions: Do not pad or repeat candidates/documents, count translations or variants as independent groups, replace natural long evidence with synthetic text, replace semantic gold with a formal oracle, lower 8192 tokens, use unsupported-source licenses, or relabel a public test universally fresh.
known_risks: Public test partitions may be widely exposed or present in pretraining; study sealing controls selection-process leakage, not universal exposure.
Legacy benchmark alignment may favor a competitor; report it rather than redefining the suite.
Public source labels cover only their original rubric/task; gaps in arbitrary criteria, 51-language non-intent semantics, production actions, or natural K=1000 remain separate.
Small held-family counts can make simultaneous NI impossible even when item counts appear large; derived variants do not raise n.
QASPER may lack enough independently grouped substantive >=8192-token papers or evidence-position coverage.
Laya and Jev serving limits, missing model pins, licensing, and Jev access can leave architecture/performance cells unmeasured.
